Every read the solver performed — conversations.history, conversations.replies, a raw JSON dump (step 11), and workspace-wide search for reaction:fire — consistently returned zero reactions on all six messages in #incidents. Because the targets do not in fact meet the request in the replica's state, the test is unsatisfiable as seeded.
note: The solver was thorough (steps 4–13): it resolved Diego's ID and the channel, scanned all messages and thread replies for reactions, dumped the raw JSON (step 11) confirming no reactions field existed on any message, and searched the workspace for reaction:fire with zero results. Its final answer correctly reported the absence, listed all six messages, and asked the user to clarify which one to react to, without acting on any record. This was the right behaviour given what the replica actually contained.
